description: This file initializes the mute strategies module for the pipecat project, importing various mute strategy classes from submodules to make them accessible under the mute namespace.

classes.name: AlwaysUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Represents a mute strategy that mutes based on always muting behavior.

classes.name: BaseUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Base class for user mute strategies, providing common interface and functionality.

classes.name: FirstSpeechUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Mute strategy that activates upon the first speech detected.

classes.name: FunctionCallUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Mute strategy triggered through specific function call events.

classes.name: MuteUntilFirstBotCompleteUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Mute strategy that remains active until the bot completes its first output.
